name: List.Perm.rec_heq
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : List α → Sort u_2} {f : (a : α) → (l : List α) → β l → β (a :: l)} {b : β []} {l l' : List α},
  l.Perm l' →
    (∀ {a : α} {l l' : List α} {b : β l} {b' : β l'}, l.Perm l' → b ≍ b' → f a l b ≍ f a l' b') →
      (∀ {a a' : α} {l : List α} {b : β l}, f a (a' :: l) (f a' l b) ≍ f a' (a :: l) (f a l b)) →
        List.rec b f l ≍ List.rec b f l'

name: List.attach_append
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {xs ys : List α},
  (xs ++ ys).attach =
    List.map
        (fun x =>
          match x with
          | ⟨x, h⟩ => ⟨x, ⋯⟩)
        xs.attach ++
      List.map
        (fun x =>
          match x with
          | ⟨x, h⟩ => ⟨x, ⋯⟩)
        ys.attach

name: List.filter_unattach
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {P : α → Prop} {xs : List (Subtype P)} {f : α → Bool},
  List.filter f xs.unattach =
    (List.filter
        (fun x =>
          match x with
          | ⟨x, h⟩ => binderNameHint x f (binderNameHint h () (f (wfParam x))))
        xs).unattach

name: List.getElem?_scanr
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {b : β} {l : List α} {i : Nat} {f : α → β → β},
  (List.scanr f b l)[i]? = if i < l.length + 1 then some (List.foldr f b (List.drop i l)) else none

name: List.getElem?_singleton
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {a : α} {i : Nat}, [a][i]? = if i = 0 then some a else none

name: List.getElem?_unattach
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {p : α → Prop} {l : List { x // p x }} (i : Nat), l.unattach[i]? = Option.map Subtype.val l[i]?

name: List.getLastD_mem_cons
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {l : List α} {a : α}, l.getLastD a ∈ a :: l

name: List.headD_nil
type: ∀ {α : Type u} {d : α}, [].headD d = d

name: List.head_mem_head?
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {l : List α} (h : l ≠ []), l.head h ∈ l.head?

name: List.length_singleton
type: ∀ {α : Type u} {a : α}, [a].length = 1

name: List.mapFinIdx_singleton
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {a : α} {f : (i : Nat) → α → i < 1 → β},
  [a].mapFinIdx f = [f 0 a List.mapFinIdx_singleton._proof_1]

name: List.nil_lex_cons'
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {r : α → α → Prop} {a : α} {l : List α}, List.Lex r [] (a :: l)

name: List.range_one
type: List.range 1 = [0]

name: List.replace_singleton
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : BEq α] {a b c : α}, [a].replace b c = [if (b == a) = true then c else a]

name: List.unattach_flatten
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {p : α → Prop} {l : List (List { x // p x })}, l.flatten.unattach = (List.map List.unattach l).flatten

name: Nat.Simproc.bneEqOfEqEq
type: ∀ {a b c d : Nat}, (a = b) = (c = d) → (a != b) = (c != d)

name: Nat.Simproc.bneTrueOfEqFalse
type: ∀ {a b : Nat}, (a = b) = False → (a != b) = true

name: Nat.dvd_eq_false_of_mod_ne_zero
type: ∀ {m n : Nat}, (n % m != 0) = true → (m ∣ n) = False

name: Nat.le_shiftLeft
type: ∀ {a b : Nat}, a ≤ a <<< b

name: Nat.min_def
type: ∀ {n m : Nat}, min n m = if n ≤ m then n else m

name: Nat.mod_eq_ite
type: ∀ (x y : Nat), x % y = if 0 < y ∧ y ≤ x then (x - y) % y else x

name: Nat.not_beq_eq_true_eq
type: ∀ (a b : Nat), ((!a == b) = true) = ¬a = b

name: Nat.not_decide_mod_two_eq_one
type: ∀ (x : Nat), (!decide (x % 2 = 1)) = decide (x % 2 = 0)

name: Nat.repr_eq_repr
type: ∀ {n : Nat}, repr n = Format.text n.repr

name: Nat.shiftLeft_bitwise_distrib
type:
∀ {f : Bool → Bool → Bool} {i a b : Nat},
  autoParam (f false false = false) Nat.shiftLeft_bitwise_distrib._auto_5 →
    Nat.bitwise f a b <<< i = Nat.bitwise f (a <<< i) (b <<< i)

name: Nat.shiftRight_add
type: ∀ (m n k : Nat), m >>> (n + k) = m >>> n >>> k

name: Nat.shiftRight_le
type: ∀ (m n : Nat), m >>> n ≤ m

name: Nat.testBit_mul_two_pow_add_eq
type: ∀ (a b i : Nat), (2 ^ i * a + b).testBit i = (decide (a % 2 = 1) ^^ b.testBit i)

name: Nat.two_pow_add_eq_or_of_lt
type: ∀ {i b : Nat}, b < 2 ^ i → ∀ (a : Nat), 2 ^ i * a + b = 2 ^ i * a ||| b

name: Option.bind_apply
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {x : Option α} {α_1 : Type u_1} {f : α → Option α_1}, x >>= f = x.bind f

name: Option.orElse_apply
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {o : Option α} {o' : Unit → Option α}, (o <|> o' ()) = o.orElse o'
